name: Sandalwood Bliss
description: A warm, woody fragrance rolled by hand from pure sandalwood paste. Slow-burning and smooth, it fills the room with a calm, grounding aroma perfect for daily rituals and meditation.

name: Rose Attar
description: Delicate and floral, made with real rose extracts sourced from small organic farms. A soft, romantic scent that lingers gently without ever feeling overpowering.

name: Jasmine Nights
description: Sweet and heady jasmine, hand-rolled in small batches. Best lit in the evening, its rich floral notes create a warm, inviting atmosphere for quiet nights in.

name: Musk & Amber
description: A deep, resinous blend of natural musk and amber resin. Earthy and long-lasting, this is our most robust organic scent — ideal for larger spaces.

name: Ocean Breeze
description: A crisp, airy fragrance formulated with minimal synthetic compounds for a clean, fresh scent that clears a room in minutes. Long-lasting throw, everyday use.

name: Citrus Burst
description: Bright, zesty, and energising. A responsibly formulated citrus blend designed to lift the mood of any space without overwhelming the senses.

name: Vanilla Musk
description: A cosy, comforting blend balancing sweet vanilla with soft musk. Formulated to be gentle yet long-lasting, ideal for everyday spaces.

name: Lavender Dream
description: Calming lavender notes formulated for consistent, long-lasting fragrance. A soothing choice for winding down at the end of the day.
